experiments.paper_location: Sections 4.3-4.4: WTA candidate selection and sparse neural computation
experiments.mechanism: Execute translated reduction, dense index, key generation, tiled WTA hash and candidate wrapper contracts on a real SYCL CPU device.

conditions.execution: shared SYCL kernels submitted to required actual CPU device
conditions.subgroup_policy: query actual subgroup/work-group IDs; never assume width or contiguous lane mapping
conditions.oracle: independent integer/scalar FP64 sums, maxima, dense IDs, minstd sequence, WTA buckets, frequencies and cyclic padding

experiments.note: Support adaptation: actual subgroup collectives, local-memory block trees and concurrent atomics; direct-address frequencies replace native linked pool. Preserves natural-log WTA and released packed RNG precedence variant. Source identities and distinct original source-defect reproductions are retained. Does not execute original CUDA reductions/hash wrappers or native ownership, lock progress, stream ordering or GPU scheduling. #34/#43 remain open.
